assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, female mouse liver (S2.8.p1, S2.9.p1)
sample_inclusion: 15 female livers, 5 per group: Adult (6 mo, vehicle), Old (22 mo, vehicle), PDX (22 mo, Protectin DX gavage 9 wk) (S3.7.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of aging (Old vs Adult) and of Protectin DX treatment (PDX vs Old) on liver gene expression. The study has no exercise intervention: treadmill exhaustion and voluntary wheel running are physical-performance assessments given to every mouse in every group (S2.2.p1, S2.4.p1, S2.4.p7, S2.4.p9).
planned_contrasts: Old vs Adult (aging; S3.7.p2: 1,621 genes at FDR q < 0.05)
PDX vs Old (drug; S3.7.p2: 0 genes at FDR q < 0.25)
paper_method: DESeq2 Wald test, pairwise groups, BH FDR; featureCounts Ensembl gene counts (S2.9.p1-p2)
paper_results: Old vs Adult 1,621 DEGs FDR<0.05; PDX vs Old 0 DEGs FDR<0.25; Hallmark GSEA (S3.7.p3)
